UI FANOUT PASS 4 — RESPONSIVE POLISH / ACCESSIBILITY / PERFORMANCE. Audit the Onslaught source reconstruction as a senior UI systems engineer. Identify and fix the highest-value UI polish issues that the other passes might miss: responsive behavior across desktop and phone landscape, safe-area use, text scaling, contrast, focus/keyboard behavior where relevant, reduced-motion friendliness, pointer/touch coexistence, layout stability, CSS maintainability, and avoiding expensive paint/filter effects during a Three.js game. Keep the visual language cohesive with a dark survival zombie shooter. Do not turn the game into a conventional app UI and do not disturb working gameplay or mobile input architecture. Return a conservative coherent unified diff within the allowlisted source-reconstruction scope, plus exact tests the lead should run. Do not claim tests were run.
